title: MERC Allows Net Metering with Open Access for Rooftop Solar Project
summary: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (MERC) has partly allowed a private company's petition seeking net metering arrangements for its 660 kW rooftop solar power project while availing green energy open access. The Commission directed the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company (MSEDCL) to reconcile the petitioner's, GKN Driveline (GKNDIL), billing from November 10, 2023, until the month preceding the billing cycle from which the net metering benefits were extended. Any excess amount recovered must be adjusted or refunded to GKNDIL with applicable interest.
